assets.name: stage
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final landscape background artwork for a Korean browser detective game, 마지막 커튼콜.
Create one full-scene 1536x1024 landscape illustration, cinematic painterly realism with detailed believable material textures. No typography.
Scene: a small, old Korean theater. Audience-facing centered view from the front of the auditorium, looking onto the entire proscenium and stage. Deep burgundy velvet drapery frames the proscenium, worn dark wood surrounds, warm amber theater lights illuminate a wooden stage. Cool teal work lights subtly color the edges and backstage exit gaps.
Critical composition: a large OPEN EMPTY CENTRAL STAGE FLOOR, fully visible and unobstructed, suitable for separate game-object overlays. A plain translucent gray scrim stretches behind the playing area. Practical dark exit gaps are visible at both stage left and stage right. A scenic painted window/set panel stands toward the left third of the stage, leaving the central playing area empty. Subtle stage rigging and practical theater fittings add realism. Include only a few red auditorium seat backs along the very bottom edge, with a clear view of the stage.
Mood: quiet, atmospheric, slightly mysterious, readable game background, artful cinematic light but not excessively dark.
Constraints: NO people, NO body, NO mannequin, NO CHAIR OR FIGURE at the center or elsewhere on the stage. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, interface, arrows, borders, panels, montage, or split screen. The scrim remains plain and the central floor remains empty.
assets.observed: Centered proscenium, burgundy drapery, amber-lit open central stage floor, plain translucent gray scrim, exit gaps on both sides, scenic window at left third, red seat backs at bottom. No central chair or figure. There is small furniture at the far-left scenic panel, outside the open central area.

assets.name: backstage
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final landscape backstage background artwork for a Korean browser detective game, 마지막 커튼콜.
Create one full-scene 1536x1024 landscape illustration, cinematic painterly realism with detailed believable material textures. No typography.
Scene: spacious backstage and wardrobe workroom in a small old Korean theater. The same visual world uses burgundy velvet cloth, worn dark wood, cool teal work lights and subtle warm amber practical light. Eye-level wide interior composition, highly readable environmental detail.
Placement: a wood dressing table with a mirror on the left; a large corkboard on the center-back wall; wooden drawers and a storage cabinet at the right. Include blank paper, cloth tape, hanging coats, old stage props, and half-full mugs. Papers pinned to the board are BLANK or illegible abstract marks only, never readable lettering. An open working tabletop spans the lower part of the scene; leave the BOTTOM-CENTER TABLETOP relatively clear and open for interactive game-object overlays. Keep this tabletop comfortably lit and visible.
Mood: quietly tense empty theater workroom, lived-in craft environment, spacious enough to explore, realistic wear, dust, wood grain, fabric texture, cinematic atmosphere without losing visibility.
Constraints: no people, no body, no mannequins, no readable text, letters, words, logos, watermarks, interface, game UI, borders, panels, montage, split screen, or graphic arrows. One coherent room.
assets.observed: Mirror and dressing table left, large corkboard center-back, storage drawers beneath and wardrobe right, cool teal and warm amber lighting. Foreground worktable has a large clear center, with cloth and props at its edges. No people, no readable lettering.

assets.name: props
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a precision game prop atlas for a Korean browser detective game, 마지막 커튼콜.
Create ONE wide 1536x1024 PNG raster with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND and true alpha; no opaque background, no checkerboard baked into the image. Arrange exactly SIX separate photographed/painterly objects in an EXACT regular 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX equal 512x512 cells. The grid is invisible: NO grid lines, borders, labels, or text. Each entire object must fit completely inside its assigned cell with at least 12% transparent margin on all sides. Nothing crosses any cell boundary. No shadows outside objects or across cells.
Shared style: cinematic painterly realism, realistic material texture, old Korean theater props, worn dark wood, subdued burgundy/teal/amber palette. The two occupied-chair views depict the SAME exact chair, mannequin and dark long coat. All three chairs share the same simple worn wooden chair design.
TOP LEFT cell (x 0-512, y 0-512): front-facing full wooden chair, all legs and back visible, with a SEATED articulated wooden artist mannequin inside a loose dark long coat. Silhouette resembles a seated elderly man. The coat conceals most of the mannequin, with a plain wooden artist-manikin head partly hidden by the high collar and wooden jointed hands or feet allowed. NO actual human skin and NO actual human. Entire chair and entire seated figure contained in the cell.
TOP MIDDLE cell (x 512-1024, y 0-512): the SAME chair and SAME seated articulated wooden artist mannequin in the SAME coat, now in a three-quarter side view. Coat pulled slightly open, exposing unmistakably wooden ball joints, wooden torso and articulated wooden elbow. All chair legs and head fit inside this cell. It must be unmistakably a wooden mannequin.
TOP RIGHT cell (x 1024-1536, y 0-512): the SAME empty wooden chair, front-facing, all legs and back visible, no mannequin and no coat.
BOTTOM LEFT cell (x 0-512, y 512-1024): one SINGLE circular antique BRASS clasp, large frontal macro product view. Perfectly frontal and outer circle symmetrical. Ornate six-petal floral relief, radial fine etched scratches, distinctive mottled antique patina, crisp high-contrast texture. This one object nearly fills its cell while preserving the 12% transparent margin.
BOTTOM MIDDLE cell (x 512-1024, y 512-1024): one SINGLE OVAL SILVER belt clasp, clean geometric oval shape, frontal macro view, reflective worn silver texture, clearly different silhouette and metal from the brass clasp. Large in its cell with 12% transparent margin.
BOTTOM RIGHT cell (x 1024-1536, y 512-1024): one SINGLE EBONY SQUARE clasp with a RED inset, perfectly frontal macro view, dark polished wood and vivid deep-red center. Clearly square silhouette, large in its cell with 12% transparent margin.
Precision constraints: exactly 6 isolated items in the specified positions. No extra objects, no stands, no human skin, no duplicate clasp fragments, no captions, no typography, no graphic arrows, no logo, no watermark, no decorative frame. All THREE bottom clasps are whole intact objects, not fragments. Their rich high-contrast surface textures will be divided by CSS clipping into puzzle fragments, so show each clasp clearly and sharply. Preserve true transparency around every object.
assets.observed: All six requested objects in a 3x2 arrangement: frontal seated wood mannequin, three-quarter seated wood mannequin, empty chair; circular six-petal brass clasp, oval silver clasp, square ebony red clasp. Rich textures, no labels. Critical failure: the output has an opaque checkerboard baked into RGB pixels, not true alpha. Exact 12% margins were also not preserved: some objects approach cell edges. No retry or edit was made under the one-call-per-asset constraint.

integration: Original PNGs preserved. CSS grid crops select each prop. Clasp shapes and puzzle fracture masks crop the same original object at runtime. The silhouette uses an sRGB luminance-to-alpha lighting filter; work views use a bright matte treatment. No second generated viewpoint or bitmap retouch was used. Waveform audio is original deterministic PCM in lib/curtain-audio.ts, generated with scripts/curtain-audio.ts.
